sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def wincheck(tag):
    r=last_action_result or {}
    flags={k:r.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward') if k in r}
    # scene change: check level
    lvl=current_frame.level
    if flags or (r.get('board_changed') is False and False):
        print("WIN?",tag,flags,"lvl",lvl)
    return flags
seq=[('L','LEFT'),('U','UP'),('R','RIGHT'),('R','RIGHT'),('D','DOWN'),
     ('RED',{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}),
     ('L','LEFT'),('L','LEFT'),('U','UP'),('R','RIGHT'),('R','RIGHT'),
     ('BLU',{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}),
     ('L','LEFT'),('L','LEFT'),('D','DOWN'),('R','RIGHT'),('R','RIGHT'),
     ('RED',{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}),
     ('L','LEFT'),('L','LEFT'),('U','UP'),('R','RIGHT'),('R','RIGHT')]
for i,(tag,a) in enumerate(seq):
    action([a])
    r=last_action_result or {}
    if any(r.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')):
        print("STOP at",i,tag,r); break
    # detect big scene change
    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # right panel non-black count
    nb=sum(1 for rr in range(6,58) for cc in range(33,64) if L[rr][cc] not in ('B','W'))
    if i%5==0:
        print(i,tag,"lvl",current_frame.level,"rightcolored",nb)
print("done tour, lvl",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
